capabilities: Preview Day Planner schedules for a date range
Choose add, skip, update or duplicate per item
Sync selected items to Apple Reminders
Check the status of the last sync request
extras: Requires a one-time manual helper installation outside the vault; the helper is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized. The community listing is not yet approved. Sync is one-way and has no automatic or scheduled runs.
intentEvidence: Export saved Day Planner schedules to Apple Reminders and optional Calendar events from Obsidian.
motivation: To plan on a Mac and view the schedule on an iPhone through iCloud without syncing the entire vault.
problem: Day Planner schedules live only in Obsidian daily notes, so they are not visible in Apple Reminders or Calendar on iPhone without syncing the whole vault.

summary: Obsidian plugin that previews and selectively syncs saved Day Planner schedules to Apple Reminders and optional Calendar events on macOS.
